## Summary
Build BizBook, a full-stack appointment CRM: a NestJS + Prisma (SQLite) JWT-authenticated API with role-based access, serving a React + Vite + React Router SPA, deployed as a single container.

## Scope
### Files to create

**Repo root**
- `package.json` — workspaces (`backend`, `frontend`) + root scripts (`build`, `seed`, `start`)
- `Dockerfile` — multi-stage: build frontend → build backend → run node serving both; runs migrations + seed on start
- `.dockerignore`, `.gitignore`, `.env.example` (`DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`, `PORT`)

**Backend (`backend/`)** — NestJS + TypeScript
- `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `nest-cli.json`
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — models: `User`, `Client`, `Service`, `Appointment` (see Step 1)
- `prisma/seed.ts` — seed users/clients/services/appointments; print `SEED_CREDS_JSON=...`
- `src/main.ts` — bootstrap, global `ValidationPipe`, `/api` prefix, serve SPA static fallback
- `src/app.module.ts`, `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts` + module
- `src/auth/` — `auth.module.ts`, `auth.controller.ts` (`POST /api/auth/signup|login`, `GET /api/auth/me`), `auth.service.ts`, `jwt.strategy.ts`, `jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `roles.guard.ts`, `roles.decorator.ts`
- `src/clients/` — module, controller (`GET/POST /api/clients`, `GET/PATCH /api/clients/:id`, `GET /api/clients/:id/appointments`), service, DTOs
- `src/services/` — module, controller (`GET /api/services` all roles; `POST /api/services`, `PATCH /api/services/:id` ADMIN-only via `RolesGuard`), service, DTOs
- `src/appointments/` — module, controller (`GET /api/appointments?date=`, `POST /api/appointments`, `PATCH /api/appointments/:id/status`, `GET /api/appointments/today`), service (double-booking check), DTOs
- `src/revenue/` — module, controller (`GET /api/revenue` ADMIN-only), service (group-by-month aggregation)
- `src/health/health.controller.ts` — `GET /api/health`, `GET /api/health/deep` (DB ping)

**Frontend (`frontend/`)** — React + Vite + TypeScript
- `package.json`, `vite.config.ts` (dev proxy `/api` → backend), `index.html`, `tsconfig.json`
- `src/main.tsx`, `src/router.tsx` (route table with `data.flow` nodes)
- `src/api/client.ts` — fetch wrapper attaching JWT, 401 → redirect `/login`
- `src/auth/AuthContext.tsx`, `src/auth/ProtectedRoute.tsx`, `src/auth/RoleRoute.tsx` (ADMIN gate)
- `src/components/AppShell.tsx` — header showing **"BizBook"** on every page + nav (revenue/services-edit hidden for USER)
- `src/pages/`: `Login.tsx`, `Signup.tsx`, `Today.tsx`, `ClientsList.tsx`, `ClientForm.tsx`, `ClientDetail.tsx`, `Services.tsx`, `ServiceForm.tsx`, `DayView.tsx` (appointments), `BookAppointment.tsx`, `Revenue.tsx`

### Dependencies
- Backend: `@nestjs/*`, `@nestjs/jwt`, `@nestjs/passport`, `passport-jwt`, `prisma`/`@prisma/client`, `bcryptjs`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`
- Frontend: `react`, `react-dom`, `react-router-dom@6`, `@tanstack/react-query`, `vite`, `typescript`
- DB: SQLite (file-based, bundled — no external service)

### Integrations
- None (no third-party APIs/SDKs)

### Assumptions
- Stack chosen (greenfield, no constraints): NestJS + Prisma + SQLite + React/Vite/React Router; JWT auth (per baseline for React/NestJS).
- `full_auth` model: login, signup, logout, guards on all app routes; first user → ADMIN, subsequent public signups → USER. Public routes: `/login`, `/signup`, `/api/health`, `/api/health/deep`.
- Time slots: 30-min increments (`HH:MM`), business day 08:00–18:00 in the booking picker.
- "Taken slot" = existing appointment at same `date`+`startTime` with status ≠ `cancelled`; enforced by partial-unique index + service check.
- Revenue grouped by appointment-date month (`YYYY-MM`), summing `service.priceCents` of `completed` appointments only.
- Single container serves SPA + API; SQLite migrated + seeded on container start.

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Data model & migrations
**File:** `backend/prisma/schema.prisma`
**Change:** Define `User{id,email(unique),passwordHash,name,role(enum ADMIN|USER),createdAt}`, `Client{id,name,phone,email?,notes?,createdAt}`, `Service{id,name,durationMin(int),priceCents(int),createdAt}`, `Appointment{id,clientId→Client,serviceId→Service,date(DateTime, date-only),startTime(String HH:MM),status(enum scheduled|completed|cancelled|no_show, default scheduled),createdAt}`. Add unique index on `(date,startTime)` for active bookings (enforced in service layer since SQLite lacks partial-unique filtering on enum; store cancelled as separate check). Generate initial migration.

### Step 2: Auth module
**File:** `backend/src/auth/*`
**Change:** `signup` hashes password (bcrypt), assigns ADMIN if zero users else USER, returns JWT. `login` verifies + returns JWT `{sub,role,name}`. `JwtStrategy` validates token; `JwtAuthGuard` global except `@Public()` routes. `RolesGuard` + `@Roles('ADMIN')` decorator for admin endpoints. `GET /api/auth/me` returns current user.

### Step 3: Clients API
**File:** `backend/src/clients/*`
**Change:** CRUD for clients (all authenticated roles). `GET /api/clients?q=` list with optional name/phone search; `POST` validates name+phone required; `GET /api/clients/:id` detail; `GET /api/clients/:id/appointments` returns past + upcoming appointments (joined service) ordered by date/time; `PATCH /api/clients/:id` edit.

### Step 4: Services API with role gate
**File:** `backend/src/services/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/services` for all roles (used by booking picker). `POST`/`PATCH` guarded by `@Roles('ADMIN')` → USER receives 403. Validate `durationMin>0`, `priceCents>=0`.

### Step 5: Appointments API + double-booking
**File:** `backend/src/appointments/*`
**Change:** `POST /api/appointments` validates client/service exist; rejects with 409 + message `"Time slot already booked"` if an active appointment exists at same `date`+`startTime`; else creates with status `scheduled`. `GET /api/appointments?date=YYYY-MM-DD` returns that day's appointments in time order with client (incl. phone) + service. `GET /api/appointments/today` returns today's list + `tomorrowCount`. `PATCH /api/appointments/:id/status` updates to completed/cancelled/no_show.

### Step 6: Revenue API (ADMIN)
**File:** `backend/src/revenue/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/revenue` guarded ADMIN-only; aggregates `completed` appointments joined to service prices, grouped by `YYYY-MM`, returns `[{month, totalCents, count}]` sorted desc.

### Step 7: Health + static serving
**File:** `backend/src/health/*`, `backend/src/main.ts`
**Change:** `/api/health` → `{status:'ok'}`; `/api/health/deep` → runs `SELECT 1` via Prisma. In `main.ts`, serve `frontend/dist` statically with SPA fallback to `index.html` for non-`/api` routes.

### Step 8: Seed script
**File:** `backend/prisma/seed.ts`
**Change:** Create 1 ADMIN + 1 USER (known passwords), 5 clients, 4 services (incl. "Haircut" 30min/$25), ~10 appointments spread across yesterday/today/tomorrow with mixed statuses (scheduled/completed/cancelled/no_show) at distinct time slots. Print `SEED_CREDS_JSON={"admin":{...},"user":{...}}` to stdout. Idempotent (skip if users exist).

### Step 9: Frontend routing & auth
**File:** `frontend/src/router.tsx`, `frontend/src/auth/*`
**Change:** Routes (each with `data.flow` node): `/login`, `/signup` (public); `/` → redirect `/today`; `/today`, `/clients` (`?q=`), `/clients/new`, `/clients/:id`, `/clients/:id/edit`, `/services`, `/services/new` (ADMIN), `/services/:id/edit` (ADMIN), `/appointments?date=`, `/appointments/new`, `/revenue` (ADMIN) — all wrapped in `ProtectedRoute`; admin routes in `RoleRoute`. `AuthContext` stores JWT (localStorage) + user; logout clears + redirects.

### Step 10: Frontend pages
**File:** `frontend/src/pages/*`, `frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx`
**Change:** `AppShell` header always renders "BizBook" + role-aware nav (hide Revenue + service-edit for USER). `Today` lists today's appointments in time order with phone + tomorrow count. `ClientsList`/`ClientForm`/`ClientDetail` (detail shows contact + appointment history). `Services` catalog + `ServiceForm` (admin only; USER sees no create/edit controls). `DayView` reads `?date=`, shows appointments in time order with status-change controls. `BookAppointment` picks client/service/date/slot, surfaces the 409 double-booking message inline. `Revenue` shows month-grouped totals. All data via TanStack Query.

### Step 11: Dockerfile & build
**File:** `Dockerfile`, root `package.json`
**Change:** Multi-stage build (frontend `vite build` → backend `nest build` + `prisma generate`); runtime stage runs `prisma migrate deploy && node prisma/seed.js && node dist/main.js`. Expose `PORT`.

## Testing Strategy
- **Auth/roles:** login as seeded ADMIN and USER; confirm USER gets 403 on `POST /api/services` and `GET /api/revenue`, and Revenue/service-edit nav absent.
- **Clients:** create client → appears in list + has `/clients/:id` page showing history.
- **Services:** ADMIN adds "Haircut 30/$25" → appears + selectable in booking.
- **Appointments:** book free slot → status scheduled, shows in `?date=` day view in time order; book same slot → 409 + no row created; change status → reflects in day view + client history.
- **Today:** `/today` lists today's appts with phones + tomorrow count.
- **Revenue:** completed appts sum grouped by month.
- **Routing:** every state deep-links (paste URL fresh → correct view).
- **Health:** `/api/health` and `/api/health/deep` return ok. Verify `SEED_CREDS_JSON` printed on seed.

## Risks
- Double-booking uniqueness enforced in service layer (SQLite partial-unique on enum is limited) — must wrap check + insert to avoid races; acceptable for single-instance demo.
- SQLite file resets if container storage is ephemeral — fine for demo, note for production (swap `DATABASE_URL` to Postgres later; Prisma keeps this a config change).
- Seeded credentials are public by design for demo use.
